rows.en: －　Corridor　－
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０１９Oh! Perfect timing!!￥I was just looking for you.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２０Hey, tell me...￥Do you like ghost stories?
Yeah, I do. Why?
Not really...
Yes, I love them.
They kind of scare me...
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２１Really? That makes this easy.￥Have you heard the rumor that￥the Cafeteria is haunted?
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２２We're planning a test of courage￥tonight to see if it's true.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２３Oh yeah? Don't tell me you're￥a scaredy-cat!
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２４So there's a rumor the Cafeteria￥is haunted, and we're planning￥a test of courage there.＝＠２０５＿０２５I'd love to see you scared~
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２６I figure it's just some sick￥joke somebody started, though.＝＠２０５＿０２７Still, don't you want to know￥what's really going on?
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０２８Come on, let's go.＝＠２０５＿０２９Everyone's already gathered on￥the Common Floor.
＊Yoh＊＠２０５＿０３０Stuff like this is always more￥fun with a bigger crowd.＝＠２０５＿０３１I really want you to come.
Sounds fun. I'm in.
I don't know...
Sounds fun. I'm in.
I don't know...
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００１Great!＝＠１９１＿００２A test of courage is way more￥fun with someone cute by your￥side, don't you think?
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００３Guy or not, with someone as cute￥as you, it'll be a blast.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００５Okay, everyone's already￥waiting, so let's get going.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００４But if I show up with someone as￥cute as you, they'll be jealous~
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００５Okay, everyone's already￥waiting, so let's get going.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００６Aww, what?￥Come with me.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００７If a ghost really shows up,￥I'll chase it off for you.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿００８Besides, without you we've got￥an odd number.＝＠１９１＿００９Then someone has to go alone.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０１０Please! Do me a favor and come!￥Everyone's waiting.
－　Common Floor　－＝－　Some candidates are gathered　－
＊Kaname＊＠１９１＿０１１Ah!! Cousin came too!!＝＠１９１＿０１２Yoh, you're late. Everyone's￥already paired up and waiting.＝＠１９１＿０１３Let's hurry up and start!
＊Kaname＊＠１９１＿０１１Ah!! Cousin came too!!＝＠１９１＿０１２Yoh, you're late. Everyone's￥already paired up and waiting.＝＠１９１＿０１３Let's hurry up and start!
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０１４Sorry, sorry!￥Okay, let me explain the rules.

＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０１５I gathered you all here tonight￥for a test of courage.＝＠１９１＿０１６Once, in Alpha's service bay, a￥mechanic got locked in storage￥with a broken lock and starved.＝＠１９１＿０１７He must have died hungry,￥begging for something to eat.＝＠１９１＿０１８Ever since, they say a￥mummy-like ghost roams the￥Cafeteria, searching for food...
＊Eiji＊＠１９１＿０１９Ooooh!
＊Kaname＊＠１９１＿０２０Eek! That's so scary!
＊Riko＊＠１９１＿０２１I-I-I'm not scared of that!
＊Amane＊＠１９１＿０２２Wow! I wanna see it!
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０２３Now, you'll split into pairs￥and walk to the Cafeteria!＝＠１９１＿０２４For the pairs, let's see...
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０２５Oh, wait. Looks like you've all￥already paired up.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０２６Then... hey,￥you'll pair up with me, right?
Yeah, of course.
No choice, is there?
Sure, why not.
I guess I have to.
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０２７Thanks. I planned this whole￥thing just so I could pair up￥with you~
＊Yoh＊＠１９１＿０２８Sure, but I set this whole thing￥up because I wanted to go with￥you from the start, you know?＝＠１９１＿０２９We're partners now, so let's￥have fun instead of complaining.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿００１Okay, let's decide the order.＝＠１９２＿００２Everyone draw a lot...＝＠１９２＿００３And we're... Ugh?!￥Sorry, we're dead last.
＊＊－　The pairs set off in turn...　－
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿００４Finally, it's our turn.￥Shall we?
＊＊－　Cafeteria　－
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿００５I kind of forced you into this,￥didn't I? Sorry.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿００６But just like I thought, with￥someone as cute as you...＝＠１９２＿００７it's fun, ghost or no ghost~
＊Yoh＊...＝＠１９２＿００８Come to think of it, this place￥has other scary stories besides￥the Cafeteria mummy.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿００９They call them the Seven￥Mysteries of Alpha...
Tell me about them.
Classic ghost stuff.
What are the others?
Classic ghost stuff.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１０Huh?＝＠１９２＿０１１Aw, you're not scared at all.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１２Truth is, I don't even know￥all of them myself.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１３Stories like these are mostly￥just rumors... I wonder if the￥mummy one is made up too.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１４Right?! Ghost stories like these￥are almost all made up.＝＠１９２＿０１５I wonder if any of them￥are true.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１６Maybe the mummy story here￥actually happened...
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１７Still, nothing's shown up.￥Guess it was just a rumor...
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１８Hey, did you hear something?￥From that corridor over there...
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０１９There, again!￥I definitely heard something!
Yoh, go check it out!
Okay, I'll go look!
Yoh, will you go look?
Should I go look...?
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０２０Yeah, of course.￥You stay right here.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０２１No, you wait here.￥If anything happens, yell.
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０２２Who's there?!
＊????＊＠１９２＿０２３Hey!!￥Don't you "Who's there" me!
＊Narusawa＊＠１９２＿０２４The Cafeteria closed hours ago!＝＠１９２＿０２５What are you doing here￥at this hour?!
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０２６Oh, it was you, Narusawa.￥You scared me...
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０２７Um... We heard the rumor about a￥ghost here, and we got curious￥and came to check it out.＝＠１９２＿０２８Then we heard a noise, so we￥figured it was the ghost...
＊Narusawa＊＠１９２＿０２９Do you two even understand￥why you're here?
＊Narusawa＊＠１９２＿０３０It's late.￥Get back to your rooms, now!
＊Yoh＊＠１９２＿０３１We're very sorry.
－　On the way back　－＝－　A figure on the Common Floor　－
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００１Oh! There you are!! Where have￥you been? I've been looking all￥over for you!
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００２Come on, let's hurry and go do￥the test of courage!
What do you mean?
We just went together!
What do you mean?
We just went together!
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００３What? Are you messing with me?＝＠１９３＿００４Don't tell me you're gonna say￥you already went...?￥...
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００５No way... Could it be...
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００６Huh?￥What are you talking about?
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００７Could it be...
＊Yoh＊＠１９３＿００８Who did you go with...?
